sources.release_vintage: D0401.7; reference year 2022; exact publication timestamp to verify during file ingest

sources.title: Sub-national Water Resource Accounts, 2015 to 2021
sources.geography: Breede, uMngeni and Mooi catchments in two Water Management Areas
known_limits: Sub-national and selected catchments, not a national census.
Resource accounts do not establish delivered municipal service, drinking-water quality or household access.
Hydrological years must not be silently treated as calendar years.
sources.next_action: Retrieve main document and companion Excel tables; record every workbook/sheet, units, hydrological-period definitions, model status and missingness.

sources.next_action: Create one record per report/table rather than treating the publication index as a dataset.

sources.time_basis: financial/reporting year details to verify in source
